name: DBG console auto-closes when the admin panel opens (bob = admin)

steps._comment: bob is an admin (verified by zz-flag-diagnose). Also restarts the dev server if not already active.
FTUE coach overlay can sit on top of the lobby
DBG chip only renders for admins — its presence double-confirms bob is admin
PRECONDITION: console panel is genuinely open before we test that it closes

steps.expression: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('[data-testid=debug-input]'); el.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key:'Enter', bubbles:true})); return 'enter-sent'; })()
steps._comment: DebugConsole submits on Enter keydown (HUD.jsx handleKey)
admin cmd is async (trpc admin.isAdmin) — overlay appears only after it resolves
THE ASSERTION: console chat closed itself once the admin panel opened

steps.expression: (() => { const t = document.querySelector('[data-testid=admin-tab-config]'); if (!t) return 'no-tab'; t.scrollIntoView({inline:'center', block:'nearest'}); const r = t.getBoundingClientRect(); return 'x=' + Math.round(r.x) + ' vw=' + window.innerWidth; })()
steps._comment: Records the Config tab position. The tab bar is now an auto-fit grid that wraps (no horizontal scroll), so every tab is already in view and the scrollIntoView here is a harmless no-op kept only for the x/vw readout.
Sanity: the admin panel is actually interactive, not just mounted behind a dead console
